summary: Transport smoke: the pinned DeepSeek V4.1 guide limits its contract to TP2×PP2
method: Read the pinned public source document, retained its exact qualification language, and bounded the finding to the documented topology.
finding: The pinned DeepSeek V4.1 guide describes an experimental Gaudi 2 serving contract of TP2×PP2 and explicitly says that enabling it does not establish model, numerical, memory, or performance validation. It does not provide a single-card result.
scope: Pinned source commit 5fa3e08302716d458a82aa7d95d107e201b51d8c; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Gaudi 2; documented TP2×PP2 serving profile.
uncertainty: No hardware run was performed. This is source-reported documentation and intentionally duplicates the retained topology caution for transport verification.
recommendedAction: Do not generalize this profile to TP1; test one transferable optimization on a single card before promotion.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prepared execution
sources.exactExcerpt: This experimental profile is under qualification. Enabling a switch is not evidence of completed model, numerical, memory or performance validation. The serving contract is Gaudi2, TP2×PP2, one request and greedy sampling.
sources.relevance: The excerpt bounds the documented topology and verification strength for the topology-transfer question.
